sections.title: Reporting treaties and multilateral summits
sections.content: In diplomatic narration, agreements between rulers are introduced with prepositional verbs: *megállapodik vmiben* (to agree on something) followed by *abban, hogy...* (in that...). This pattern is central to describing historical treaties like the 1335 Congress of Visegrád.

items.spanish: A három király megállapodott abban, hogy új kereskedelmi utat nyitnak.
items.english: The three kings agreed that they would open a new trade route.

items.spanish: Károly Róbert közvetítő szerepet vállalt a lengyel és cseh uralkodó között.
items.english: Charles Robert undertook a mediator role between the Polish and Bohemian rulers.

items.spanish: A felek egyezséget kötöttek a bécsi árumegállító jog elkerüléséről.
items.english: The parties concluded an agreement on bypassing Vienna's staple right.
